name: workflow
description: Technical/functional mediation commands and agents (/analyst, /arquiteto, /flow, /spike, /qa, /infra) — /flow can also implement the epics autonomously up to a single pull request — plus skills for test-failure triage, code review, commit conventions, migrating a legacy .claude/ to these plugins and an exploratory HTTP client for the local API. Also /grill-me, a round-based interview that /flow also uses to grill its specialist agents, domain-modeling, which keeps the project glossary (GLOSSARY.md) and ADRs, /loop-me, which grills you into specs for the recurring workflows you want to delegate, and design-an-interface, which designs a frontend module's interface twice (or more) before /spike implements it. Stack-agnostic — project-specific conventions live in each repo's CLAUDE.md.
